gaps.lead: We expect to announce the winner tomorrow.
gaps.explanation: We expect to announce X → X is expected to be announced.

gaps.lead: I only understood the joke much later.
gaps.explanation: After 'only + time phrase' at the front, invert: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: Cars must not exceed 30 km/h in this zone.
The suitcase was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ suitcase that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective becomes such (+a) + adjective + noun: such a heavy suitcase.

gaps.lead: I want to go somewhere where nobody knows me.
gaps.sentence: I want to go ___ nobody knows me.

gaps.lead: Nobody in the class is as tall as Petra.
gaps.explanation: X is taller than everyone = X is the tallest (person).
